AccountApplicationOpeningSubscriber.//IdentityServerAuthority: The IDP (https). Same address in every component.
AccountApplicationOpeningSubscriber.//ClientId: Must equal ClientIds:AccountApplicationOpeningSubscriber in src/IDP/appsettings.json (the IDP registers this worker's client there); its secret is ClientSecrets:<this client ID> in the IDP's settings.
AccountApplicationOpeningSubscriber.//AccountsApiBaseUrl: The Accounts API (https). Must match the address that API listens on (its launchSettings.json).
